neighbours.label: the word that completes a set phrase or idiom (a thing or two, a lot to deal with, a guaranteed success)
fire: After thirty years in the kitchen, she knows a thing or two about pastry.

With good soil and sun, tomatoes are a guaranteed success for beginners.
Our old car has been through thick and thin with us.
The coach told the team to keep their eyes on the prize.
He struggled, but the exam was a piece of cake for his sister.
When the boss left, the staff finally let off some steam.
The new manager has a lot on her plate this month.
